nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Water Gel Lotion Sunscreen SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the formula turns greasy or oily on their face and advise against it, while one combination-skin user found it fast-absorbing and glowy under retinol.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin frequently describe it as hydrating and skin-drinking, though a couple still report tightness or dry patches after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it does not irritate their skin at all and even suits sensory issues, while others report burning, stinging, redness, or rash-like irritation on the face.
segments.mature: One reviewer with aging skin likes the smooth, non-drying texture but still reports eye burning and fragrance issues.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer mentioning aging skin appreciates the hydrating, non-drying texture but still reports fragrance and eye-burning issues.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the gel texture hydrates well and leaves skin feeling smooth or dewy; a small number instead report tightness or dry patches despite the dewy look.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product irritated her cheeks with redness and rash-like feeling on first use.
concerns.barrier: No reviews specifically describe barrier repair or damage beyond general irritation reports.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product caused breakouts despite using it with her regular routine; several others explicitly state it does not cause breakouts, including on acne-scarred or acne-prone skin.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or acne-scarred skin report no breakouts and good pairing with retinol, though one reviewer reports the opposite, with horrible breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers report the product leaves skin looking or feeling greasy or oily, particularly with oily or combination skin, though several others report a lightweight, non-greasy, matte-adjacent finish.

aspects.libelle: Pills or balls up under makeup
Formula separates or discolors over time

extraits.texte: Not sure why there are so many negative reviews on this…. I have dry very sensitive skin and my skin drinks this up. It goes on smooth, no white cast, doesn't irritate my skin (my skin is very sensitive) and gives great coverage. I take this with me in my beach bag and can be sitting in the sun and I don't burn at all. Also I wear contacts and this does not irritate my eyes - even on beach vacations where I am constantly sweating still no irritation.

I tried this product since an Ulta employee recommended it when I asked for SPF for dry skin. I have acne prone + dry skin (17 yrs old). I have used better products, but wanted to save money so I tried a cheaper alternative. But I did some research and the ingredients aren't very good. Plus the smell lasts all day, pills w/ certain products, and makes my face feel greasy.

This is a great hydrating sunscreen if you have normal to dry skin. I'd stay away if you're combo or oily. I can't wear my normal moisturizer when I wear this because it makes me too oily. It's great for someone who wants to minimize the amount of products they have to use in the morning. It is heavily scented. It reminds me of fruity pebbles cereal. It does cause burning/ stinging if it gets into your eyes, but I have experienced that with other sunscreens as well. My contacts will also become blurry if I accidentally rub my eye. This has pros and cons, so it depends on skin type and what you're looking for. Great for price point.

extraits.titre: Protects my acne scarred skin! Pairs great with retinol
extraits.texte: This product replaced my lotion. I never bought the water-cream products because it seems so expensive for a tiny amount. Even though I have combination skin, it helps so much especially since the retinol I'm on for my hyperpigmentation makes my skin very dry without this lotion. It can be a bit "greasy" but to me I see it as super fast absorbing and leaves a beautiful glowy/glass look to my skin. Goes great with my Ordinary and CeraVe skincare, and has never balled up on my skin even with foundation/concealer/powder. LOVE it- and as a brown skinned girl the blue cast fades within a minute. I've bought this twice now and getting a third.

I ran out of sunscreen and decided to give this one a try while waiting for my usual to ship in. The first time I applied it, my eyes stung and it also irritated my cheeks (redness, kind of rash looking and feeling) so I rinsed it off immediately. Pro there is that it is easy to remove. Ive been applying less product and that definitely lessens the irritation but most likely makes it less effective in blocking the sun. ALSO. it pills so badly. i cant put any skin product on no concealer not even skin tint. I havent tried reapplying the sunscreen even but im scared that that will pill as well. overall i would not buy this product again.
Gave me horrible breakouts. I used it with my staple holy grail skin care products. Gave a few tries but everytime it's the same.

I like the smooth texture, glides on and is hydrating. As my skin ages, I tend to stay away from anything too drying. I do not love the scent, it is very fragrant!! AND it burns my eyes so bad!! It's really , really uncomfortable when that happens. Avoid the eye area completely when using this product. Will finish using product but will NOT repurchase until the formula improves.
